sentence_1_it: Lei era una ragazza dai capelli dorati.
sentence_1_en: She was a girl with golden hair.
sentence_2_it: Era una ragazza dai capelli dorati.
sentence_2_en: She was a girl with golden hair.
sentence_3_it: La ragazza ha i capelli dorati.

sentence_2_it: Una chiave dorata apre tutte le porte.
sentence_2_en: A golden key opens all doors.

sentence_1_it: Va, pensiero, sull'ali dorate; // va, ti posa sui clivi, sui colli, // ove olezzano tepide e molli // l'aure dolci del suolo natal!
sentence_1_en: Fly, thought, on wings of gold; // go settle upon the slopes and the hills, // where, soft and mild, the sweet airs // of our native land smell fragrant!
